algorithm.Title: Fire Ant Sting - Female (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Female
Definition: Qatar-localized UAT-only adult and pediatric pathway for suspected fire-ant stings, screening for anaphylaxis, multiple-sting toxicity, infection and high-risk patients; species-specific Qatar governance is required before production.
FirstAid: Call Qatar 999 immediately and follow dispatcher instructions. If the patient has their own prescribed adrenaline auto-injector, use it according to its plan. Keep the patient lying down unless breathing is difficult; do not let them stand or walk and do not drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Are throat or tongue swelling, breathing difficulty, faintness, confusion, or collapse the main concern?
questions.Information: Systemic allergic-reaction features require the Anaphylaxis pathway.

questions.Question: Are the lips, mouth, throat, or tongue suddenly swollen, is the person struggling to breathe, or has anyone lost consciousness or become floppy?
questions.Information: NHS.UK insect bites and stings guidance lists these as signs of a serious allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) - use an adrenaline auto-injector immediately if available.

questions.Question: Are there multiple stings, symptoms worsening, or a previous serious allergic reaction to a sting?
questions.Information: NHS.UK guidance lists multiple stings and a prior serious reaction as reasons to seek urgent clinical review or arrange primary-care review urgently.

questions.Question: After emergency features are excluded, is any fire-ant sting suspected, including a single or few local stings?
questions.Information: Species and cumulative venom risk cannot be confirmed remotely; this Qatar UAT pathway requires prompt clinical assessment rather than medication-led self-care.

advice.Title: Emergency allergic reaction precautions
Content: Call Qatar 999 immediately and follow dispatcher instructions. If the patient has their own prescribed adrenaline auto-injector, use it according to its plan. Keep the patient lying down unless breathing is difficult; do not let them stand or walk and do not drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: symptoms persist or recur; loss of consciousness.

advice.Title: Urgent sting review
Content: Apply a cold compress and arrange same-day medical review, especially with multiple stings or a prior reaction history.
Call Back If: swelling spreads; breathing becomes difficult.

advice.Title: Prompt assessment for local ant stings
Content: Move away from further exposure, gently wash the area, avoid squeezing pustules or applying unverified products, and arrange prompt review through the Qatar pathway approved for UAT. Medication requires age, weight, pregnancy, allergy, comorbidity and interaction checks.
Call Back If: swelling worsens; systemic allergy or infection develops.

references: NHS.UK, "Insect bites and stings", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/insect-bites-and-stings/ (page last reviewed 01 June 2023)
